result.title: JetDiffusion: Pushing the Speed Limits of Video Generation with NVFP4 Sparse Attention
result.summary: Attention over long sequences is a major computational bottleneck in video generation, which can be alleviated through sparsity and low-bit quantization. We propose JetDiffusion, a video generation system built on trainable Video Sparse Quantized Attention (VSQA), with custom inference kernels that combine native NVFP4 computation and kernel fusion. At 90% sparsity, VSQA accelerates attention by 8-29x compared with FlashAttention on different hardwares. To further accelerate video generation, we combine VSQA with NVFP4 linear quantization and step distillation. Although each technique can individually preserve generation quality, jointly adapting to all three remains challenging, particularly under aggressive NVFP4 quantization. Through empirical studies, we develop an effective staged training recipe that enables stable adaptation to quantization, sparsity, and few-step denoising. On Wan2.1-14B, the resulting model achieves 273x end-to-end video generation speedup on the RTX 5090 while maintaining comparable video quality.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 JetDiffusion，将可训练的视频稀疏量化注意力（VSQA）与 NVFP4 计算、自定义推理内核及步数蒸馏结合，并用分阶段训练配方在 Wan2.1-14B 上实现大幅端到端视频生成加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作目标是视频扩散采样的吞吐与量化/稀疏内核优化，未涉及视觉推理中的内部状态表示、证据获取或停止决策；其分阶段训练仅服务于生成质量保持，与 LVR 的训练监督或状态更新缺乏具体可核查的联系。
